alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A kitchen with a small food container on the floor between two small block figures with white eyes, an ink-black one on the left and a brick red one on the right. A bubble above the black one says take the rest and the container slides across the floor to the red one. The red one's eyes go wide and then happy and a bubble says thank you! Then it says I'll bring it back, and the black one answers no rush with happy eyes and a pulse. The text stays: me lending the container with no due date. The last card: Choose friction.
comentario_fijado: A small friction, chosen on purpose.
